title: Finishing Pages, step 2 — the file chooser, round 2

steps.path: A page used from your phone's browser → Open a file
steps.headline: Both have a list / tiles switch, search, sortable columns and quick places. Where should the quick places sit?
steps.notice: List (left picture) shows when each file changed and its size, and the column names sort. Tiles (right picture) show small pictures, about six to a row. The switch is the two icons at the top right of the files.

variants.label: Places in a row above
variants.summary: Home, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures as a row of buttons over the files. The files get the full width; the same on a computer and a phone.

variants.label: Places in a column beside
variants.summary: The places as a column on the left, like a computer's file window. Feels familiar on a computer; on a phone it falls back to the row above.

steps.headline: On a phone the places scroll sideways, the list drops the date column, and tiles fit three to a row.
steps.changed: Same chooser, full width, Open over Cancel at the bottom.
steps.notice: The places row scrolls sideways when it does not fit.

steps.path: A page saving a new file, from your phone's browser
steps.headline: Saving uses the same chooser, with the file name box under it.
steps.changed: 'Save a file', the same files card, then 'Save as' with the page's suggested name.
steps.notice: Tapping an existing file puts its name in the box; saving over it will ask first.
